# Experience

Total experience needed for each character level. Every class uses the same table.

The last column is the share of experience a character of that level keeps from each kill (1024 = all of it). Above level 69 it drops sharply: at 98, a character gets 6/1024 of the experience a level 69 character would. Experience from monsters far below or above the character's level is reduced separately; see [Experience](../mechanics/experience.md).
